subject: Infra isolation slate + action list for SOC 2 evidence
messages:
From: Evan Clarke <evan.clarke@atlantis-financial.com>
To: maya_srinivasan@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: security-ops@atlantis-financial.com
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Infra isolation slate + action list for SOC 2 evidence

Hi Maya / Kimberly,

Thanks again for taking this on. Atlantis is kicking off our SOC 2 readiness review and we need a concise, auditor-friendly packet that explains how Redwood separates Dedicated and Private deployments from a network and control perspective. Specifically we need:

- A one-page annotated topology that shows control-plane vs data-plane boundaries for both Dedicated and Private.
- Callouts for where KMS/HSM keys are used (customer-managed vs Redwood-managed).
- Evidence pointers for egress controls and tenant fencing (logs, ACLs, VPC peering assertions).
- A mapping table to the SIG/CAIQ network controls (which doc/diagram satisfies each question).

Deadline for initial packet: Friday 2026-10-09 EOD PT. If you can’t make that, please propose an interim deliverable by Thursday.

Also: can you include any known deviations/constraints for air-gapped on-prem installs? We’ll need the caveats documented.

Thanks,
Evan Clarke
Audit Manager, Atlantis Financial
security-ops@atlantis-financial.com
[Attachment: Atlantis-audit-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: maya_srinivasan@redwood.com <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Evan Clarke <evan.clarke@atlantis-financial.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 13:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Infra isolation slate + action list for SOC 2 evidence

Evan —

Appreciate the clear asks. We’ll deliver a compact packet that maps diagrams to SIG/CAIQ questions and include a short appendix for air-gapped/on‑prem notes.

Plan:
1) Deliverable A (by Thu 2026-10-08 17:00 PT): annotated topology PNG + one-page summary (high-level controls).
2) Deliverable B (by Fri 2026-10-09 EOD PT): full evidence zip (PDF diagrams, mapping CSV, sample logs pointers).

Initial attachments: isolation-overview-v1.pdf (draft annotated topology), control-roster-q3.csv (which lists owner/contact for each control). I’m sharing a Drive folder with the working files: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B-example/Isolation-Evidence

Quick clarifications so we don’t chase later:
- For KMS boundaries: do you want us to mark the default Redwood-managed flow and an explicit alternate for customer-managed keys? We’ll include both, and call out which deployments support CMK.
- For egress proof: we can include VPC flow log samples + iptables/NACL snippets. Confirm those are acceptable.

Looping in Kimberley and Tessa for control mapping and log samples.

Thanks — will push v1 shortly.

—
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Security Architect, Redwood Inference
maya_srinivasan@redwood.com
[Attachment: isolation-overview-v1.pdf (diagram)]

From: Evan Clarke <evan.clarke@atlantis-financial.com>
To: maya_srinivasan@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 09:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Infra isolation slate + action list for SOC 2 evidence

Thanks, Maya — that timeline works. A few clarifications from our side:

- KMS: please show both flows but explicitly label which deployments allow customer-managed keys (only Hosted Dedicated + Private with KMS integration).
- Egress: we prefer VPC flow logs + a short excerpt of the egress ACL applied to the edge subnets. A one-paragraph note on how we detect anomalous outbound connections is helpful.
- Air-gapped installs: we only need a short statement of feasibility and the operational caveats (no outbound telemetry, manual patch process, local KMS).

One ask: could you include a single slide that summarizes "evidence location" (Drive path + file name) so our auditors can grab files directly?

If Deliverable B arrives early, we’ll start internal review and raise clarifying Qs.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—
Evan Clarke
Audit Manager, Atlantis Financial

From: maya_srinivasan@redwood.com <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Evan Clarke <evan.clarke@atlantis-financial.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Infra isolation slate + action list for SOC 2 evidence — packet delivered

Evan —

Attached: dedicated-private-topology-annotated.png, isolation-overview-final.pdf, control-roster-q3.csv, evidence-index-slide.pdf. The Drive folder contains the raw flow log snippets and the CAIQ/SIG mapping CSV.

Summary of what we included (short):
- Topology: clear control-plane vs data-plane demarcation for Hosted, Dedicated, Private; CMK callouts; HSM-backed signing zone indicated.
- Egress controls: edge subnet NACL excerpt + VPC flow log sample (redacted) and the detection playbook reference (Ops runbook ID: OPS-314).
- Air-gapped note: feasibility confirmed; operations caveats: no external telemetry, manual patch process, and encrypted transport required for assembly.
- Mapping: an itemized CSV linking each SIG/CAIQ network question to the exact file and slide that satisfies it.

Attachments: dedicated-private-topology-annotated.png; isolation-overview-final.pdf; control-roster-q3.csv; evidence-index-slide.pdf
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B-example/Isolation-Evidence
DocuSign (for evidence attestation): https://docusign.com/envelopes/0aEXAMPLE12345

Next steps: if Atlantis needs signed attestations on any of these docs, say the word and I’ll route to Legal for the standard audit attestation. If you have follow-ups on the detection excerpt or CMK labelling, Kimberly (cc’d) will provide the technical snippet.

Thanks —
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Security Architect, Redwood Inference
maya_srinivasan@redwood.com
[Attachments: dedicated-private-topology-annotated.png (image), isolation-overview-final.pdf (PDF), evidence-index-slide.pdf (PDF)]
